name: terser
description: Token efficiency for Codex with a six-tool source index, exact source ranges, opt-in command output deltas, session continuity, and loop detection.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve exact source and reduce repeated context in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Find and verify symbol source, request exact file ranges, and reuse verified results from the current turn. Terser includes an opt-in command runner with recoverable output deltas, local usage diagnostics, and session continuity.
defaultPrompt: Show Terser status, token savings, and session quality grade.
Audit this project's token waste, micro-skills, and unused tools.
Use terser-index to map key symbols and trace blast radius with minimal tokens.
